payload.posture: Read Mark 14:26–31 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after the hymn, Jesus predicts scattering and a later meeting in Galilee; Peter and the others answer with claims of loyalty. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
